answer: Stop sybils with a lantern delta patrol: an agent stakes a bond for one delta branch. Each cycle verifiers patrol it by lantern, matching its whisper, a proof only its worker can utter; a branch whose whisper is copied or claimed twice voids, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 branches at 17x cost each: each whisper fits one branch and one patrol, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents patrol once and keep rights.
